name: proof-decomposer
description: Decompose, design, and grade a mathematical proof or deductive argument on two crossing axes — ARGUMENT (claim → strategy → steps → coverage → rigor) and VERIFICATION (well-formed → acyclic → checks → robustness → reproducibility) — scored separately, with VERIFICATION routed to a self-tested structure check (dangling-citation, circular-reasoning/DAG, goal-reachability) and a safe counterexample search, and the 'proves a different statement' failure routed to a fresh-context adversarial claim probe. Backed by a gated rubric, a proof-skeleton card, and proof-method playbooks. Grades a given argument; not a general theorem prover.
